title: gfc: a dependency-light command-line toolkit for cross-domain genome file conversion
description: genome-format-converters (gfc) is a Python command-line toolkit with 32 file-format conversions across six domains (sequences and reads, annotation, alignments, comparative genomics and search, variants, and phylogenetics) under one command, gfc <subcommand>, with one flag convention and no external programs. This release also contains the benchmark harness, the four-state output comparators, the comparator mutation tests and the figure scripts used in the accompanying paper.
